name: student.isViewAllowed
description: Check that the logged in user matches the accountId or If studentSchoolId is present, check that the logged in user has access on the student’s school.

inputs.name: accessType
inputs.description: This is accessType. Enter S or R.

steps.description: getting the logged in user details
fetch userId from loggedInUser
If externalUser and accountIds is not provided and studentId not null, fetch the distinct accountIds from guardian table joining with student_guardian for the studentId

properties.value:
SELECT json_agg(g.account_id) AS "accountIds" FROM student s
JOIN student_guardian sg ON sg.student_id = s.id AND sg.record_status='ACTIVE'
JOIN guardian g ON g.id = sg.guardian_id AND g.record_status='ACTIVE'
WHERE s.id = '#{studentId}'
properties.name: SQLQuery

entryCondition.expression: #{accountIds} eq null and #{studentId} ne null and #{isExternalUserBoolean} eq true

steps.description: if externalUser, Check if loggedInUserId exists in accountIds list, If not, then return False, with message “Invalid student”.

entryCondition.expression: #{isExternalUserBoolean} eq true

steps.description: if externalUser and not validUser, exit from here with message “Invalid student”

conditionalExit.expression: (#{isExternalUser} eq true  or #{isExternalUser} eq 'true') and #{validUser.size()} eq 0

entryCondition.expression: (#{isExternalUser} eq true  or #{isExternalUser} eq 'true') and #{validUser.size()} eq 0

steps.description: if external user, checking whether application is open for epStageId

properties.value: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM enrollment_stage WHERE id='#{epStageId}' AND (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP BETWEEN opening_time AND closing_time) AND closed= false)THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END as exists;
properties.name: SQLQuery

entryCondition.expression: #{applyApplicationWindow} eq true and #{epStageId} ne null and #{isExternalUserBoolean} eq true

steps.description: if external user and epStage notopened, return false with message “Application entry is closed for this stage”

inputs.value: "Application entry is closed for this stage"
inputs.name: object

entryCondition.expression: #{applyApplicationWindow} eq true and #{epStageId} ne null and (#{isExternalUser} eq true  or #{isExternalUser} eq 'true') and  #{checkApplicationOpen}  ne null and   #{checkApplicationOpen[0].valid} eq false

steps.description: Validate that applicationId is present in the student_guardian.user_permissions->'processOwned'->'applications' @> to_jsonb(a.id::text) for the guardianId

properties.value:
SELECT EXISTS ( 
 SELECT 1
    FROM guardian g inner join student_guardian sg on g.id = sg.guardian_id inner join application a on a.student_id =sg.student_id 
    WHERE user_permissions->'processOwned'->'applications' @> to_jsonb('#{applicationId}'::text) 
    AND g.id in (select g.id from guardian g2 where g.account_id = '#{loggedInUserId}')
) as valid
properties.name: SQLQuery

entryCondition.expression: #{applyApplicationWindow} eq true and #{epStageId} ne null and (#{isExternalUser} eq true  or #{isExternalUser} eq 'true') and  #{applicationId}  ne null

steps.description: if externalUser and no error so far, then return true and exit from here
